description: Live viewer hardening: the floating preview always renders the watch-only preview token (never a control link), the green efficiency-dot overlay is removed from every deployed viewer copy, and duplicate viewer relays plus orphaned headless Chromes are reaped automatically so one browser and one stream stay alive.
features: Floating preview forced to the preview token on every path (server, engine media, client guard); control still opens only as handoff card / edge tab.
Green efficiency dot hidden idempotently in the deployed viewer page (package + served copies, re-applied after upgrades).
Stale-viewer reaper: newest websockify relay kept, extras killed; orphaned /tmp-profile Chromes killed and their stale dirs removed (X5 live Chrome never touched).
Version synced to 0.16.0 in server APP_VERSION, pyproject.toml and updates.json.
